verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a GPU machine catalog that includes NVIDIA H100, though high-end machines require an approval request. It also offers older options such as Ampere A100 (up to 8 GPUs) and, per a user report, a Quadro P6000. Users can change instance types to balance cost and performance. Missing for 10: any evidence of H200 or B200 availability, self-serve (un-gated) access to H100, and a documented per-model price comparison between current and previous-generation GPUs.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: There are several machine types grouped by CPU, GPU, and multi-GPU. If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
Build & Run AI/ML Models on NVIDIA H100 GPUs
Leverage the latest NVIDIA GPUs including Ampere A100s with up to 8 GPUs.
Easily change instance types anytime so you always have access to the mix of cost and performance.
